# Orbit Carousel, Tilted Sphere

A denser sphere of cards turned a quarter turn, so the spin runs sideways across the frame. Product cards are drawn (gradient panel, glyph, title from a list); an optional images variable swaps in photos.

Category: motion-graphics. Length: 6 s. WebGL: no.

Use when:
- A set of products, menu items, categories or tiles should take turns in front of the camera as a showcase.
- A fuller cloud than carousel-orbit-1 is wanted.

Avoid when:
- A sparse, airy cloud is wanted: use carousel-orbit-1.

Variables:
- titles (string): Card titles, default "Linen Shirt, Ceramic Mug, Canvas Tote, Oak Stool, Wool Throw, Glass Vase, Field Notebook, Desk Mat, Soy Candle, Clay Planter, Tea Set, Cutting Board"
- palette (string): Card colours, default "#0a0a0a, #2563eb, #f4f4f5, #27272a, #e4e4e7, #1d4ed8"
- images (string): Images, default ""
- show_glyphs (boolean): Glyphs, default true
- card_radius (number, 0-50): Corner radius, default 3
- speed (number, 0.25-3): Speed, default 1
- background (color): Background, default "#ffffff"

Source: heygen-com/hyperframes. Licence: Apache-2.0. The scene file keeps the upstream notice.
